available.doc: criteria for the mechanic to be available, regardless of what is here one must have a government reform with the mechanic in its government_mechanic = { } block.

ai_chance.doc: AI weighting block for options: factor = base relative weight.

cooldown_desc.doc: defines the string to use for the name of the cooldown. If not specified, it will use the name of the interaction.

cooldown_token.doc: Token to use on cooldown, can be re-used across actions to make them all be put on cooldown when any is used

cost_type.doc: Must be one of the costs defined in its powers

base_monthly_growth.doc: How much it grows by each month

gui.doc: link to the gui that will be used to display this power. By default, it will be government_shared_power if it's not a power only associated with one action, or if it is a unique power for one interaction, this will be ignored and the bar from the interaction's gui will be used. New versions of this will need to contain the same elements so they can be filled in.
